response.justification: Candidate is a strong, versatile full-stack/backend engineer with deep experience in TypeScript, Node.js, DLang, and web platforms, but this role requires a C++/STL specialist with 8-12 years focused on high-performance, multi-threaded, networked systems and industrial cybersecurity (IEC 62443). His C++ experience is minimal and over a decade old (2014-2015 at National Instruments), with no evidence of message brokers, MQTT, REST-based IoT work, UML/architecture documentation, or SDL/IEC 62443 security practices. The core technical stack mismatch is too significant for this specialized industrial automation role.
strengths: 15+ years of diverse, high-caliber software engineering experience across multiple domains
Demonstrated experience with async I/O, fibers, and low-latency high-throughput systems (DLang at Sociomantic)
Strong ownership, mentoring, and community involvement (talks, workshops, open source)
concerns: Minimal and dated C++ experience (~6 months, over 10 years ago), not the primary focus of career
No evidence of MQTT, message brokers, REST-based IoT, or industrial protocols (Modbus, OPC UA, etc.)
No mention of IEC 62443, Secure Development Lifecycle, or industrial cybersecurity practices
